quotes.speaker: Aday Mara
quotes.summary_phrase: Aday Mara on the demands of the NBA season
quotes.excerpt: The season is long, guys. We have to enjoy the time we have off-season.

text_blocks.speaker: Aday Mara
text_blocks.text: The season is long, guys. We have to enjoy the time we have off-season, because then the season is very demanding. It's true that there are fewer months, but they are very concentrated games. I wish you the best of luck, except when you play against the Celtics.

text_blocks.speaker: Baba Miller
text_blocks.text: And nothing, for the rest, just stay focused all season. There are ups and downs, but you have to take it well.

text_blocks.speaker: Sergio de Larrea
text_blocks.text: And take advantage of the opportunity, right?

text_blocks.speaker: Hugo González
text_blocks.text: Correct.

quotes.speaker: Aday Mara
quotes.summary_phrase: Aday Mara on finding a routine for NBA recovery
quotes.excerpt: Find a routine that helps you concentrate and activate before games and also have a post-game routine.

text_blocks.speaker: Aday Mara
text_blocks.text: Find a routine that helps you concentrate and activate before games and also have a post-game routine for correct recovery.

text_blocks.speaker: Hugo González
text_blocks.text: That was emphasized in the Rookie Transition Program, which you didn't attend. They emphasized that aspect a lot.
